reviews.title: Stupid ads
reviews.text:
Im sick and tired of seeing ads for this game where people (These are full-grown women, in case you were wondering) don’t even realize that they have fingers that aren’t their thumbs. (Shows what years of mindless doomscrolling on TikTok does to people’s brains). Way to go! If you keep this marketing strategy, you may win the award for ‘Apple’s lowest rated app’! YAY. I’d rather watch a two-minute long misleading Royal Match ad (Don’t worry, there will be about ten of those whenever you are trying to play a single part of one of the three real songs) than have to put up with five seconds of whatever this is. That should say a lot.

Even a CAT could play this game better, and all they do is sit around licking their butts all day, and get treated like Cleo-Cat-Ra. A CAT. They don’t even have opposable thumbs, and their brains are somehow smaller than the people in the ads.

So, yes, if you absolutely HAVE to download a game on here, just get ASHline (Which was created by a 5th grader that used AI to do all the heavy lifting), which is still somehow better than this. 

Just spare yourself of this game. Go touch grass or something. 

I’ve just hit my head to the point where there’s a large bump, and I’m still taking my time to type out this review. Doesn’t that show my pure hatred?
